# SnapReelDownload

Free online video downloader for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Twitter, and more.

## Description
SnapReelDownload is a web-based utility designed to help users archive publicly available video content for personal offline viewing. It supports various platforms and provides high-quality MP4 and MP3 downloads without requiring login or registration.

## Features
- No Watermark: Clean video downloads.
- HD Quality: Support for 1080p and 4K where available.
- Multi-platform: Works with Instagram (Reels, Stories, Photos), TikTok, YouTube (Videos, Shorts), Facebook, and X (Twitter).
- Fast & Secure: SSL encryption and fast server-side processing.
- Device Compatibility: Works on iOS, Android, Windows, and Mac.

## Compliance
We only support publicly available content and respect creator privacy settings. This tool is intended for personal, non-commercial use only.
